long power(long x, long y, long p) {
    if (y == 0) return 1;
    if (x == 0) return 0;
    long res = 1L;
    x = x % p;
    while (y > 0) {
        if (y % 2 == 1) res = (res * x) % p;
        y = y >> 1;
        x = (x * x) % p;
    }
    return res;
}

void sieveOfEratosthenes(int n) {
    prime = new bool[n + 1];
    for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) prime[i] = true;
    for (int p = 2; p * p <= n; p++) {
        if (prime[p]) {
            for (int i = p * p; i <= n; i += p) prime[i] = false;
        }
    }
}

long binomialCoeff(long n, long r) {
    if (r > n) return 0L;
    long m = 1000000007L;
    std::vector<long> inv(r + 1, 1);
    if (r + 1 >= 2) inv[1] = 1;
    for (int i = 2; i <= r; i++) {
        inv[i] = m - (m / i) * inv[(int)(m % i)] % m;
    }
    long ans = 1L;
    for (int i = 2; i <= r; i++) {
        ans = ((ans % m) * (inv[i] % m)) % m;
    }
    for (long i = n; i >= (n - r + 1); i--) {
        ans = ((ans % m) * (i % m)) % m;
    }
    return ans;
}
